n5d2ee35f5b.headline: Indebted Venezuela will issue its own cryptocurrency “Petro”, announced its president
n5d2ee35f5b.summary: Venezuela announced plans to issue its own cryptocurrency called 'Petro' amid its ongoing economic crisis and indebtedness.
n5d2ee35f5b.why: Issuing a state-backed cryptocurrency is an unconventional economic measure aimed at circumventing sanctions and addressing liquidity issues in Venezuela's economy.
